title: Historical seismogram archives
summary: IRIS reports about 50 million analog seismograms worldwide, many at risk of disappearance.
what_to_recover: Prioritize scanning; transcribe station bulletins; recover historical waveform timing and event parameters.
validation_note: Preservation is incomplete and funding dependent; availability varies by station and event.

title: ICOADS historical marine observations
summary: Surface marine observations span 1662-present with successive releases and documented corrections.
what_to_recover: Archive every release; diff added/deleted/corrected observations; trace source provenance.
validation_note: NOAA documents prior corrections and deletions, making this a prime audit target for historical data transformations.

title: Piltdown Man
summary: The remains were artificially modified and assembled from different species; later chemistry, imaging and DNA work clarified the fraud.
what_to_recover: Archive specimens, tests and chain-of-custody evidence as an authentication benchmark.
validation_note: Natural History Museum maintains original records and modern forensic reassessment.

title: Harvard astronomical photographic plates / DASCH
summary: ~550,000 glass plates encode a century of sky observations and can reveal long-term variability.
what_to_recover: Preserve raw scans, DR7 products, plate metadata, logbooks and release history; cross-match modern surveys.
validation_note: Legacy Cannon portal retired; current access uses DR7/daschlab/Starglass. The project also documents a 2021 database crash and later reprocessing.

title: Undigitized marine logbooks and Coast Guard/lightship records
summary: ICOADS rescue documentation identifies archival collections not yet incorporated into the global dataset.
what_to_recover: Locate physical collections; scan/transcribe; reconcile against ICOADS.
validation_note: A direct pool of potentially valuable but incompletely digitized observations.

title: iDigBio and natural-history specimen collections
summary: US collections contain roughly a billion specimens; most historical specimen information is not yet online.
what_to_recover: Target undigitized collections with high temporal/spatial value; capture labels, images, coordinates, dates and taxonomy.
validation_note: Absence online does not imply absence from physical collections.

title: N-rays
summary: Independent observers failed to reproduce the claimed radiation; Wood showed the reported effect persisted without a supposedly essential component.
what_to_recover: Use as a control-design and observer-bias benchmark.
validation_note: Nature published Wood’s 1904 critique; APS documents the rapid collapse of the claim.

title: Charon discovery from archival plates
summary: US Naval Observatory photographic plates revealed changing elongation of Pluto images, leading to the discovery of Charon.
what_to_recover: Catalog plate epochs and original reductions; compare archival and modern astrometry.
validation_note: Concrete proof that old imagery can contain previously unextracted discoveries.

title: NOAA paleoclimatology archive
summary: More than 10,000 proxy datasets cover tree rings, ice cores, corals, sediments and other natural archives.
what_to_recover: Version/provenance crawl; identify sparse-metadata and difficult-to-access legacy datasets.
validation_note: NOAA is migrating systems to cloud infrastructure, creating a need to preserve stable identifiers and old access paths.

title: Hawaiian Volcano Observatory historical seismograms
summary: Thousands of paper seismograms span more than a century; most moved to the National Archives after the 2018 eruption.
what_to_recover: Map custody, digitize records, georeference stations, align with modern seismic catalogs.
validation_note: Primary problem is provenance/custody rather than a vanished record set.

title: Weather Rescue at Sea
summary: Millions of 19th-century Royal Navy ship-log observations were transcribed for climate reconstruction and reanalysis.
what_to_recover: Acquire machine-readable observations and QC corrections; locate remaining untranslated logs.
validation_note: 2026 paper documents handwriting, terminology and metadata problems that need explicit uncertainty modeling.

title: Historical DNA from museum specimens
summary: Modern sequencing can recover useful genomic information from old museum and herbarium specimens.
what_to_recover: Identify old specimens tied to range loss, taxonomic uncertainty and pathogen history; maintain sampling provenance.
validation_note: Literature supports feasibility but warns about degradation bias and contamination controls.

title: 1907 Sumatra earthquake archival seismograms
summary: Historical seismograms from multiple observatories were used to reassess the unusual 1907 earthquake and tsunami.
what_to_recover: Recover scans and bulletin phase times; rerun modern inversion and tsunami modeling.
validation_note: Published example of archival waveform recovery producing better historical characterization.

title: Retraction/correction metadata graph
summary: Crossref exposes post-publication metadata; literature shows data and analysis errors are important causes of retraction.
what_to_recover: Link papers, datasets, corrections, retractions and replications; flag changed evidentiary foundations.
validation_note: Cross-check registries because retraction metadata itself can contain errors.

title: CORHIST: 200 years of Great Lakes spawning history
summary: USGS converted archival, field, interview, Indigenous Ecological Knowledge and specimen evidence into a geospatial historical database.
what_to_recover: Generalize the methodology to other taxa/regions and connect to modern habitat layers.
validation_note: Strong template for turning fragmented historical evidence into machine-readable scientific data.

title: Worldwide plutonium fallout measurements
summary: A 1987 DOE/OSTI report contains more than 7,300 fallout measurements through 1980 with source references and locations.
what_to_recover: Extract tables, geocode sampling sites, reproduce maps and compare with atmospheric transport models.
validation_note: Historical measurements should be preserved with original units, uncertainty and source references; do not overinterpret them.

title: Polywater
summary: The anomalous material was explained by impurities/contamination rather than a new polymeric form of water.
what_to_recover: Preserve original claims and later chemical analyses as an artifact-detection benchmark.
validation_note: Primary chemical analyses found substantial impurities; later historical review documents the collapse of the claim.

title: PO.DAAC legacy access tools
summary: PO.DAAC Drive and legacy data access tools/services were retired during migration of the archive to Earthdata Cloud; the underlying data remained available through new cloud endpoints.
what_to_recover: Preserve old endpoint documentation and map every retired service to its successor; test historical scripts against replacement endpoints.
validation_note: This is an availability/interface change, not evidence that the underlying dataset disappeared.

title: Off-site radiation monitoring around US nuclear test areas, 1984
summary: DOE/OSTI records include radionuclide measurements, dose estimates, meteorology and atmospheric-dispersion calculations.
what_to_recover: Recover tables/figures and test measured-vs-modeled residuals.
validation_note: Interpret only within the monitoring network and detection limits stated in the original report.

title: Cold fusion / low-energy nuclear reaction claims
summary: A rigorous 2019 multi-institution reassessment found no evidence of the claimed effect under tested conditions, while noting interesting adjacent materials science.
what_to_recover: Separate excess-heat, nuclear-product and materials claims; demand blinded controls and reproducible calorimetry.
validation_note: Do not collapse the broad field into one binary label; the core energy claim lacks reproducible support in the cited reassessment.

title: Yerkes giant photographic plate
summary: A roughly 1 m square astronomical plate was rediscovered in an observatory attic in 2018.
what_to_recover: Digitize at archival resolution and recover exposure metadata; assess scientific content.
validation_note: Rediscovery is documented; scientific value beyond historical significance remains to be tested.
